feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 August 2026 4:25am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 30 August 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure lies to the west of Ireland, bringing a frontal zone across the area today.


##Wind##

South or southwest, veering west or northwest overnight, 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area, and in the west of the area overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then showers or longer spells of rain in the afternoon and evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest or west 3 to 5, imminently increasing 5 or 6 for a time, then backing southwest 3 or 4 later. Then increasing 5 or 6 late in the night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate at times.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
